canonicalGeometry.policy: No source polygon is canonical political authority until temporal, entity, geometry, topology, provenance, and historical review gates pass.

tiers.tier3: More distant regions; absence of Tier 3 detail must not prevent a playable 1326 scenario.

sources.licenseReview: Required before redistribution or embedding source-derived geometry
limitations: One historical interpretation of past territory

sources.provider: Stanford Digital Repository / University of Texas Libraries GeoData
sources.dataset: Digital Atlas of Dioceses and Ecclesiastical Provinces in Late Medieval Europe
limitations: Ecclesiastical geography, not a political-province authority
Useful for European historical boundary context only

sources.coverage: Historical and modern geography where mapped
sources.license: CC0 except individually tagged features with other open licenses
limitations: Collaborative source with uneven historical coverage
Individual feature license tags must be preserved and checked
Not an automatic authority for 1326 political boundaries

sources.coverage: Multi-period historical places and source-linked records
limitations: Place identity and provenance support; not a single authoritative 1326 province layer

exclusions.reason: 1300 reference material only; must not be relabeled or copied into 1326 merely to fill coverage
Paid source; not part of the free-source production pipeline

notes: This registry is not a canonical geography dataset.
Missing evidence remains missing until supported by a source or explicit reviewed reconstruction.
Political geometry and political control remain separate runtime concepts.
The first production implementation is 1326; future scenario years reuse the pipeline but are not populated by this registry.
